notes.synthetic: --synthetic builds the corpus in-memory (x23's exact convention): --n-images deterministic random RGB images, ids 1..n, each annotated with 2 categories cycled from the 16-name SYNTH_CATEGORIES pool. Synthetic POPE: 2 present + 2 absent questions per image per split ('Is there a <name> in the image?'), balanced 50/50; the absent pool is sampled uniformly regardless of split, so the popular/adversarial split NAMES exercise the per-split machinery but carry no hard-negative semantics (tiny has no real semantics)
